summary.title: Part 1 - Initial Setup
summary.one_liner: You learn how to scaffold a Go backend with go modules and a React frontend with create-react-app as the starting point for a real-time chat app.
takeaways: Initialize a Go module in a backend/ directory with go mod init and understand go.mod and go.sum.
Verify the Go setup by running a minimal main.go that prints a version string.
Generate a React frontend in frontend/ using npx create-react-app.
Start the React dev server with npm start and confirm it serves on localhost:3000.
summary.summary: This is the first part of a series building a real-time chat app with Go and ReactJS. It walks through prerequisites (npm, npx, Go 1.11+, a code editor), then creates a backend/ folder, runs go mod init, and adds a hello-style main.go to confirm Go runs. It then creates a frontend/ folder, generates the React app with create-react-app via npx, and starts it with npm start. The page is short, step-by-step, and leads into Part 2.
